tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: Deepest ground. Map and canvas voids, the well behind a scrolling list. Never for page chrome.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Application background — the ground everything else sits on. Body copy uses ink-100/ink-200/ink-300 here.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Outer panel. First raised step. Body copy uses ink-100/ink-200/ink-300 here.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Inner group inside a panel, and panel/table headers. Body copy uses ink-100/ink-200/ink-300 here.

tokens.name: surface-400
tokens.usage: Field inset, input well, row hover. Body copy uses ink-100/ink-200 here.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Inset well below surface-200 — log gutters, scroll troughs, the ruler strip in the hull editor.

tokens.name: line-100
tokens.usage: Hairline rule inside a group — field separators, table row rules. Decorative only; never the sole border of a control.

tokens.name: line-200
tokens.usage: Default 1px border on panels, boxes, inputs and buttons. Meets 3:1 on surface-100 through surface-300.

tokens.name: line-300
tokens.usage: Emphasized border — hovered control, focused group, the outer frame of a modal.

tokens.name: ink-100
tokens.usage: Primary text and values on surface-000 through surface-400, and on accent-700.

tokens.name: ink-200
tokens.usage: Field labels and secondary text on surface-100 through surface-400.

tokens.name: ink-300
tokens.usage: Meta text — timestamps, units, counts, placeholder — on surface-100 through surface-300.

tokens.name: ink-400
tokens.usage: Disabled text and disabled glyphs only. Below 4.5:1 by intent; never use for text a reader must read.

tokens.name: accent-300
tokens.usage: Accent text and icons on surface-100 through surface-400 — active tab label, selected row label, focus ring.

tokens.name: accent-500
tokens.usage: Accent fill — primary button, active tab bar, selection handle. Pair with on-accent for text.

tokens.name: accent-600
tokens.usage: Accent border and pressed-state rule. A mark, not a text ground — meets 3:1 on surface-100 through surface-300.

tokens.name: accent-700
tokens.usage: Accent wash — selected row background, active list item. Carries ink-100.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on accent-500. Never place ink-100 on accent-500.

tokens.name: status-red
tokens.usage: Violation text and labels on surface-100 through surface-300. Always paired with a word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: status-red-mark
tokens.usage: Violation fill — severity bar, hostile track, error dot. Marks only, no text on it.

tokens.name: status-red-wash
tokens.usage: Violation row background. Carries ink-100 and status-red.

tokens.name: status-amber
tokens.usage: Caution text and labels on surface-100 through surface-300. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: status-amber-mark
tokens.usage: Caution fill — severity bar, unknown track, advisory dot.

tokens.name: status-amber-wash
tokens.usage: Caution row background. Carries ink-100 and status-amber.

tokens.name: status-green
tokens.usage: Nominal text and labels on surface-100 through surface-300. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: status-green-mark
tokens.usage: Nominal fill — health pip, complete segment of a progress bar.

tokens.name: status-green-wash
tokens.usage: Nominal row background. Carries ink-100 and status-green.

tokens.name: glyph-navy
tokens.usage: Icon and glyph ink across the interface, and friendly tracks on the map. Meets 3:1 on surface-100 through surface-400.

tokens.name: glyph-navy-deep
tokens.usage: Icon plate behind a glyph-navy mark, and the friendly threat envelope on the map.

tokens.name: glyph-navy-wash
tokens.usage: Icon tile background in a catalog list. Carries glyph-navy and ink-100.

tokens.name: map-void
tokens.usage: Orbital and planetary map canvas. Darker than surface-100 so the schematic reads as a window, not a panel.

tokens.name: map-orbit
tokens.usage: Orbit rings, trajectory arcs and the station ruler baseline.

tokens.name: map-grid
tokens.usage: Background grid, range rings and the dotted graticule on the planetary editor.

tokens.name: map-zone
tokens.usage: Habitable-zone band and frost-line fill. Always labelled — never the only cue.

tokens.name: map-belt
tokens.usage: Asteroid belt and Trojan camp bands.

tokens.name: redact
tokens.usage: Redaction bar fill over a withheld value. Draw it with a line-200 border so the field's extent stays legible.

tokens.name: class-top-secret
tokens.usage: TOP SECRET / COSMIC banner ground. Text on it is on-accent.

tokens.name: class-secret
tokens.usage: SECRET banner ground. Text on it is ink-100.

tokens.name: class-confidential
tokens.usage: CONFIDENTIAL banner ground. Text on it is ink-100.

tokens.name: class-unclassified
tokens.usage: UNCLASSIFIED banner ground. Text on it is ink-100.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring on every interactive element. Solid 2px, offset 1px; meets 3:1 on every surface token.

families.mono: consola, ui-monospace, "Cascadia Mono", "DejaVu Sans Mono", monospace

styles.name: label-xs
styles.usage: Uppercase micro-label above a field group or on a chart axis. Set the text uppercase yourself — no CSS transform token.

styles.name: label-sm
styles.usage: Uppercase field label in a record or inspector row.

styles.name: label-md
styles.usage: Sentence-case label on buttons, tabs and list rows.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Body copy in guidelines, advisory text and help panels.

styles.name: title-sm
styles.usage: Panel header. Set uppercase for outer panels, sentence case for inner groups.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Record title in the document header.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Boot screen wordmark and the cover. Nowhere inside the workbench.

styles.name: data-xs
styles.usage: Densest numeric column — map labels, ruler ticks, table footnotes.

styles.name: data-sm
styles.usage: Default value type in inspector rows and stat tables.

styles.name: data-md
styles.usage: Record codes, field values in a record page, log message bodies.

styles.name: data-lg
styles.usage: Headline figure in a stat tile.

styles.name: data-xl
styles.usage: Budget and point totals — one or two per screen.

styles.name: banner
styles.usage: Classification banner at the top and bottom of a record. Always uppercase.

styles.name: stamp
styles.usage: Classification badge fields, redaction placeholders and terminal stamps.

styles.name: ascii
styles.usage: ASCII progress bars, spinners and the boot-screen solar system. Tight leading so frames align.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline code, query strings and typed record paths.

spacing.note: A 4px grid with two sub-steps for dense chrome. Panel padding is space-5; field rows are space-3 apart.

tokens.name: space-0
tokens.usage: Flush edges — nested boxes that share a border.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a glyph and its label; inner padding of a pip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Cell padding in dense tables; gap between adjacent buttons in a group.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Vertical rhythm between field rows; padding inside a small button.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Padding inside an inner group box; gap between sibling groups.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Default panel padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between panels in the three-pane layouts.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Space above a section heading inside a long document.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Document margin inside a record page.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Separation between major document sections.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Boot screen and empty-state insets only.

radius.note: Near-zero by policy. A curve in this interface means the element is a tag, not a control.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Default for panels, boxes, inputs, buttons, tabs and banners.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Pips, dots and severity bars, so they do not read as pixels.

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: The only rounding allowed on a control — use on nothing but the classification badge block.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Tag chips in the record sidebar only. Never on a button.

border.note: Borders carry the hierarchy in place of shadow. Every box has one.

tokens.name: border-1
tokens.usage: Default border on every panel, group, field and control.

tokens.name: border-2
tokens.usage: Focus ring, and the outer frame of a modal or a selected map object.

tokens.name: border-3
tokens.usage: Left severity rule on a log line or advisory row — the only place a 3px border appears.

shadow.note: Elevation is a surface step plus a border. Shadow is reserved for things that float over the canvas.

tokens.name: elev-0
tokens.usage: Panels, groups, fields, controls — everything laid into the page.

tokens.name: elev-1
tokens.usage: Top seat on a header strip, to separate it from the panel beneath.

tokens.name: elev-2
tokens.usage: Dropdown, context menu and map tooltip.

tokens.name: elev-3
tokens.usage: Modal dialog over a dimmed canvas.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled control, including its border and glyph.

tokens.name: opacity-muted
tokens.usage: Deselected map object, collapsed group, inactive far-zoom label.

tokens.name: opacity-scrim
tokens.usage: Dimming scrim behind a modal.

size.note: Control heights are fixed so dense rows align across panes.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Table row, list row, small button, tag chip.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button, input, tab and select.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary action and the top-level tab bar.

tokens.name: banner-h
tokens.usage: Classification banner strip, top and bottom.

tokens.name: rail-w
tokens.usage: Left navigation rail.

tokens.name: inspector-w
tokens.usage: Right inspector and property panes.
